themes_negative: very new school / little track record
low CBR success rate (~16-29%, below average)
red_flags: Very new school (CBR-registered 2025); only ~16 Google reviews, all 5-star, no spread of opinion
No independent/verified review platform (no klantenvertellen, Trustpilot, Trustoo, Facebook)
Reviews are short generic one-liners with little concrete detail; all praise one instructor (Hikmat)
Perfect 5.0 review average contradicts CBR open data showing a low success rate (29% first-exam average; rijloket lists 16.7% for B, ~32 points below national)
review_summary: The handful of readable reviews (all 5-star Google) uniformly praise owner-instructor Hikmat as patient, professional and flexible, with a couple of students saying they passed on the first attempt; but the corpus is thin, single-platform and unverified, and the glowing sentiment sits awkwardly against CBR data showing a below-average pass rate.
